name: Christmas Mince Pies (Meat-Free)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Shortcrust pastry dough, either homemade or shop bought
Fruit mince, either homemade or shop bought

steps: Roll out the pastry dough if needed, and cut out small rounds of dough.
Line greased tartlet pans with the dough rounds.
Spoon heaped tsp of fruit mince into each tartlet shell.
Top the tartlets with slightly smaller circles of dough, preferably cut with a fluted cutter
If desired, dust pies with a light sprinkling of icing sugar just before serving.

culture.text: This is the recipe for the fruity mince pies that we all know and eat at Christmas time. These typically do not contain minced beef, but they may not be completely vegetarian since fruit mince can sometimes contain suet.
